label: Approximate original CameraSimulator background camera, manually landmark-inferred. NOT claimed recovered exact camera.

coordinateTransform.poseFormula: M_three = M_anchor * Translate(localX,localY,localZ) * Ry(yaw) * Rx(pitch) * Rz(roll). M_blender = inverse(C) * M_three. Matrices in this file are ROW-MAJOR rows; manifest flat cameraMatrix uses COLUMN-MAJOR. Camera local axes +X right,+Y up,-Z forward preserved.
coordinateTransform.positiveTranslation: localX positive camera-right, localY positive camera-up, localZ positive camera-back; fitted negative localZ means forward. UI z is negative localZ.
coordinateTransform.appEuler: Three.js Euler YXZ. scipy Rotation.from_euler("YXZ",degrees=True) uses intrinsic YXZ and matches Ry*Rx*Rz.

nearClip.important: Current 1.1m near clip would hide portions of near foreground cabinet at inferred pose. For an offline background-only comparison use clip_start0.05m (or0.1m), recording the intentional difference. Do not label clipping loss as visual model deficit. Any new foreground fan must be checked separately.

confidence.interpretation: Small residuals support a materially translated camera (roughly0.67m left/0.37m down/1.48m forward), not exact original intrinsics. Pixels hand-picked, first-surface depth may pick trim/glass/knob edge; original could differ in sensor fit/lens shift. Treat focal about25mm and pose as a useful first sample, not calibration truth. Do not present 6px residual as pixel-perfect source parity.

evidence: alignment-translation-fit.json contains all10correspondences, source depths, predictions and residuals; fit-translation.py reproduces inference.
